note: RIDDLER SEAT 4 — the absurdist. Riddle: an indifferent universe is funny if you know where your towel is. Equivalents ride this shelf (Vonnegut, Lem, Sheckley, Fforde). Everything walled.
interactions: Doctor Who: script editor, Season 17 (1979) — 'The Pirate Planet', 'City of Death' (as David Agnew), 'Shada'; gave the show its comedy-DNA
friendship and mutual admiration with Pratchett (edge: pratchett shelf)
Lem's A Perfect Vacuum (1971) — reviews of nonexistent books — invented the fake-artifact genre this engram card uses (edge: stephenson shelf)
Sheckley's 'Specialist' (1953) is the ancestor of the universe-as-ensemble gag
HHGTTG began as BBC radio (1978) — the book is the artifact of an artifact
walled: Hitchhiker's: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy (1979); The Restaurant at the End of the Universe (1980); Life, the Universe and Everything (1982); So Long, and Thanks for All the Fish (1984); Mostly Harmless (1992); And Another Thing... (2009, Eoin Colfer, sanctioned)
the original radio scripts; The Meaning of Liff (1983, w/ John Lloyd); The Deeper Meaning of Liff (1990)
Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency (1987); The Long Dark Tea-Time of the Soul (1988)
Last Chance to See (1990, w/ Mark Carwardine); The Salmon of Doubt (2002, posthumous)

Vonnegut: Player Piano (1952); The Sirens of Titan (1959); Mother Night (1961); Cat's Cradle (1963); God Bless You, Mr. Rosewater (1965); Slaughterhouse-Five (1969); Breakfast of Champions (1973); Slapstick; Jailbird; Deadeye Dick; Galapagos; Bluebeard (1987); Hocus Pocus; Timequake (1997); Palm Sunday; A Man Without a Country (2005); 'Harrison Bergeron' (1961)
